parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of decorated __init__ methods not being documented by modifying the code to unwrap the decorated object before accessing its globals.

issues.description: The patch introduces the use of `inspect.unwrap`, which is not consistent with the existing style of the codebase.
